name: Package Source Overrides
description: Configure npm, pnpm, Yarn, Corepack, pip, uv, and NuGet to use internal override package sources instead of public feeds, so other Features and your projects resolve packages through them

npmRegistry.description: Registry URL for npm, pnpm, Yarn (Classic and Berry), and Corepack. Leave empty to skip. Example: https://artifactory.example.com/artifactory/api/npm/npm-remote/

pipIndexUrl.description: PyPI index URL for pip and uv that replaces the default index. Leave empty to skip. Example: https://artifactory.example.com/artifactory/api/pypi/pypi-remote/simple

uvPythonInstallMirror.description: Mirror of the python-build-standalone GitHub releases used for uv-managed Python downloads (uv 'python-install-mirror'). Leave empty to skip. Example: https://artifactory.example.com/artifactory/github-remote/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/releases/download

nugetSource.description: NuGet v3 package source URL that replaces nuget.org. Leave empty to skip NuGet. Example: https://artifactory.example.com/artifactory/api/nuget/v3/nuget-remote/index.json

nugetSourceName.description: Friendly key/name for the configured NuGet package source

scope.description: Where configuration is written: 'system' (system-wide files), 'user' (root + remote user home), or 'both'. pnpm and Yarn Berry have no system-wide config, so their per-user files are always written

strictSsl.description: When false, allow self-signed/insecure internal proxies (npm strict-ssl=false, Yarn enableStrictSsl=false, pip trusted-host, uv allow-insecure-host, NuGet allowInsecureConnections)

bashEnvHook.description: Opt-in: export environment-variable-only overrides (e.g. COREPACK_NPM_REGISTRY) to every non-interactive bash process via BASH_ENV, so install scripts of Features that run after this one see them at build time

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container is configured to resolve packages through internal override sources (npm, pnpm, Yarn, Corepack, pip, uv, NuGet) instead of public feeds. Do not reconfigure package managers back to public registries such as registry.npmjs.org, registry.yarnpkg.com, pypi.org, or api.nuget.org.
